The incumbent uses sequence features (seq_len=50, DIN) with default L2=1e-06, which may overfit to the dense training session patterns while valid impressions per user are very sparse (p50=4). Raising L2 to 1e-05 should shrink the added sequence and interaction weights uniformly, reducing variance in within-user score differences without altering user-side first-order terms, so GAUC should stay roughly constant while nDCG@5 improves slightly due to smoother score margins. This is a small capacity-regularization change on the same identity, so the expected improvement is modest but positive.

The incumbent DIN sequence encoder (seq_len=50) adds capacity on a sparse impression set (single_imp=0.175), so a mild L2 increase from 1e-6 to 5e-6 may regularize the sequence and interaction embeddings without the large GAUC/NDCG collapse observed at 1e-5 (dP=-0.0010). This is the gentler neighbor in the regularization grid and should preserve within-user ranking while slightly reducing overfitting. If 5e-6 also lowers primary by more than ~0.0005, the hypothesis that mild L2 helps this DIN-FM identity is falsified.

The sequence arm is saturated: every 10-100 step pool/DIN variant screens within ±0.0001 of the incumbent, and the only unmeasured cell is 100-step DIN-lite. Extending the DIN attention window from 50 to 100 logged impressions gives the within-user ranking head a strictly longer behavioral context, letting the attention module down-weight stale interactions while preserving recent-item emphasis, which should slightly improve GAUC/nDCG@5 on users with long histories (train p50=31 rows/user). The 100-step pool challenger is already statistically tied (3-seed mean 0.60396, 2/3 seeds above the 0.60395 bar), so 100-step DIN is the last defensible move in this arm. This is the only untried capacity patch on this parent, so it is worth a single-screen measurement.

The earlier deepfm challenger was not an improvement, but dcnv2's cross layer is a distinct inductive bias and is still untried on this parent. Expected gain is small and may be within seed noise, hence a modest delta.
